column3: The classified software portfolio is a hard-to-substitute enabling layer for much of U.S. combat air power and the nuclear deterrent; its global bounds remain A even though it is already well known.

Collagen Hybridizing Peptides are a distinctive molecular handle on damaged collagen across diagnostics, delivery, fibrosis, and aging, with a BASF license providing a real commercialization wedge; pure impact is C until a medical program clears an IND, but the unusually broad platform is an under-recognized discovery pick.
Lease-to-own reaches real scale in both access and harm, but competing underwriters can reproduce the product and capture the same customers.
Certified composites capacity is valuable aerospace infrastructure, but the page establishes no uniquely held program position or manufacturing method that would make ACT itself structural.
The atom is Adobe's Utah engineering hub, not Adobe globally; the hub durably strengthened Utah's software ecosystem but its work could relocate within the same company.
Its record corpus and genetic-match network helped make consumer genetic genealogy mainstream and are durable, non-fungible data assets with broad privacy consequences.
The company was a real but apparently concluded commercialization attempt; rank its demonstrated company impact, not the much larger spider-silk research program it did not convert into a product.
A national esoteric reference lab coupled to an academic pathology department is structurally significant diagnostic infrastructure, although independent scale evidence remains thin.

A proteome-scale map of metabolite-protein allostery is a distinctive discovery architecture, not merely another drug candidate; roughly $299M raised, an IND-cleared program, and Fast Track designation make its path credible, while successful platform translation could redefine which targets are druggable.
The employment model is meaningful to its consultants but the page verifies no Utah operation and provides no basis for a broader company-specific counterfactual here.

Twenty-five years of OEM-agnostic off-road autonomy, deployed across multiple heavy-vehicle types with substantial operating history, gives ASI a credible path to become a horizontal autonomy layer for mines, farms, yards, and construction rather than one replaceable integration shop.
A polished and scaled SMB HR platform, but close substitutes can absorb both customers and product function.
The page cannot establish a distinctive mechanism, result, funding base, or continuing operation, so there is no company-specific ceiling to estimate.

Long-endurance VTOL aircraft paired with deployable satellite communications is a coherent austere-operations wedge and a $6M Series A makes the attempt credible; pure impact is D until field performance or a program is verified, but the combination is worth surfacing early.
Its sanctuary and national no-kill network helped alter shelter practice durably across thousands of organizations; this is structural rather than merely popular.
No primary activity after 2014 establishes a continuing company or outcome, so the former biological premise does not create current bounds.
FilmArray helped make syndromic multiplex PCR a standard hospital workflow, but rival platforms and assays bound BioFire's counterfactual below field-defining.

Synthetic heparin attacks a medically essential, geographically concentrated animal-extraction supply chain through a specific biosynthetic route; current lab scale keeps pure impact at C, while the combination of severe supply fragility and a credible technical wedge makes it a discovery pick.
The Utah Array and Blackrock hardware underlie much of the empirical BCI field, and successful clinical systems could reset communication and movement for paralysis.
A scaled installer whose panels and customers transfer readily to other installation firms; popularity and acquisition value do not make the atom structural.
Decades of firm geothermal generation are substantive proof of Utah hydrothermal power, but the grid can replace its bounded output with other resources.
The only in-force PMA for its neonatal jet-ventilation modality makes this small company unusually hard to replace for a narrow, high-depth patient group.
Low-cost accredited pathways at tens of thousands of annual enrollments across many countries can structurally widen higher-education access even though outcome evidence still bounds the claim.

Locally delivered macrophages offer a distinctive route through glioblastoma's delivery and immune-suppression barriers, with platform extension to brain metastases; pure impact is C before independent in-vivo or IND evidence, but the mechanism and disease depth merit discovery placement.

Array-based high-throughput SPR can move antibody discovery from triaging a few clones to characterizing whole libraries, and peer-reviewed use against the incumbent benchmark makes this a credible structural tools bet rather than slideware.

Real-time biomechanical coaching is an unusual, technically real consumer-hardware category; bounded recreational impact remains C, with the star marking disproportionate discovery value rather than fame.

A drop-in aviation fuel with a credible higher-energy-density performance advantage could remove both the carbon and adoption penalties in a globally hard-to-decarbonize sector; airline strategic backing makes the distinctive route plausible despite certification and scale gates.
Buyer decision research can reduce wasted product and sales effort, but consultancies and competing platforms reproduce the function without large counterfactual loss.
The company is an old and scaled locum-tenens provider, but the category-origination claim is not established and rival staffing networks can make the placements.
